summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Telefônica Brasil S.A., a Brazilian foreign private issuer, reporting the minutes of its 524th Board of Directors meeting held on May 7, 2026. The board approved amendments to the company’s 2nd Performance Unit Incentive Plan with cash settlement and elected a new member to the Nomination, Compensation and Corporate Governance Committee, replacing a departing member. These are routine governance and compensation matters with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic review. The filing does not trigger a special-situations category.
